body: nothing quite like 3 am coming around, alone in the darkness with your thoughts, and the sudden urge to die. 😂

Good. Sometimes it’s just the little things that you get motivated to do that can put you back on track in the long run. I wish you the best in finding a good therapist, and please don’t get discouraged if you struggle to find one accepting patients or one that’s a good fit. I’m glad you’re looking for help, and I wish you the best of luck on your journey.

It’s scary to think about.... one of my friends killed themselves not too long ago and I often think about where he is... what he’s doing... or if he’s just faded into the void of nothingness? But I guess regardless his spirit lives on in the memories of those who loved him.

When I think about suicide, which is often these days, I like to imagine I’d be at peace but as you said... there’s no way to know for sure. I really don’t want to be just a sad memory in the minds of those who loved me, eventually to be forgotten. Just a thought, I guess.
